decisions.reason: After another year, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot looks like the firm's preferred integrated automation platform, so its strategic fit and option value still outweigh the limited cost of keeping it offered.

The stand-alone shuttering robot still preserves a modular option for customers not ready for a combined cell, but its overlap with Product A makes it the most likely candidate for withdrawal if market learning continues to favor integrated solutions.

As a very recent multi-model line that broadens process automation within the core precast offering, uncertainty is still high and it is worthwhile to keep the option open while demand patterns become clearer.

Production analysis software complements the installed equipment base and service business, and because it is relatively inexpensive to keep on the market its learning and cross-selling value argues strongly for retention.
